notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only dated source is the 2014 extant list in the Division of Forestry multiple property document; the Tennessee Landforms list is undated and says its history is still being gathered. Agency is inferred from the tower being on that Division of Forestry list, not stated for this tower. No build date, builder, height, design, staffing or access information in any source read. Two web searches found only town, county and fire department pages. The cached NHLR Tennessee register list does not include Smithville. Access and climbing status unknown; the story tells visitors to check first and not to climb.
